next.reason: §2023:14.9.22.4 GR9 restates the 1985 BEFORE/AFTER restriction word for word (first eligible 'at the leftmost character position'; BEFORE up to 'but not including, the first occurrence'; AFTER from the position to the right of the first occurrence; no occurrence of literal-2 means 'never eligible'). Its additions concern only 2023 features: BACKWARD (absent from 1985) and 'identifier-4 references a zero-length item', which no 1985 program can produce because 1985 SR2 requires identifier-4 to be an elementary DISPLAY item. A conforming 1985 INSPECT means the same; the recheck's GR3 states the scan direction, which is 1985 GR3's subject, not this rule's.
